introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer ALL the questions (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: answer ALL four questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.

questions.enonce_markdown: Draw the truth table for the compound statement $\sim(p\wedge q)$. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Work column by column: first $p\wedge q$ (true only when both $p$ and $q$ are true), then negate it.

| $p$ | $q$ | $p\wedge q$ | $\sim(p\wedge q)$ |
|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | F |
| T | F | F | T |
| F | T | F | T |
| F | F | F | T |

The last column is false only when both $p$ and $q$ are true. (It is the same as $\sim p \vee \sim q$, by De Morgan's law.)
